name: tabvault
description: A self-hosted Guitar Pro file player. Load .gp files and play them back with MIDI, loop sections with draggable handles, adjust speed with a practice ramp, and mix individual tracks. Powered by alphaTab. No subscription required.

paths.name: Library Path
paths.description: Folder where your Guitar Pro files are stored. You can also upload files directly via the web UI.

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: Port to access the TabVault web interface
